scope: Preliminary component selection for two explicitly declared cylindrical G threaded interfaces of one straight accessible PP-R20 cold-water segment assembled from4m pipe sections. The selected adapter has the complementary thread gender. This does not prove equipment compatibility, sealing design or a full distribution system.

primarySource.exactLocator: PDF page2 section4: VTp.701 male and VTp.702 female, PP-R20 with1/2 or3/4inch thread; section3 cylindrical thread GOST6357-81. Each adapter has one PP-R fusion socket.
